visualIdentity: Approved neutral Miss Julie, blue blazer, white blouse, beige trousers

actions.description: Hello, Grade One! Miss Julie waves at the school gate. Animated school doors open.
Bunny skipping game. Julie shows hopping fingers. Children say I can skip.
Playground race. Julie's fingers run and a tiny rocket races past. I can run.
Footsteps on a sunny path towards school. I walk to school.
Silly smiling elephant peeks from behind a tree. I can smile.
School bell rings while the school clock animates. I hear a bell.
A cheerful frog jumps over a small puddle. I can jump.
A ball bounces by the playground. I can play.
Friends walk into the classroom; an open classroom door appears.
Grade One celebration with balloons and Miss Julie. Short bilingual encouragement and next voice adventure.
